recognize_zh: 極低倍周邊血液抹片中，整片視野散布大量帶有不規則尖刺的小而緻密紅血球（acanthocytes）與鋸齒狀 echinocytes，並非只在抹片邊緣出現，提示這是真實、瀰漫的紅血球形態改變；配合 alectinib 用藥史指向藥物引起的棘狀紅血球症。
features: Diffuse population of spiculated red cells throughout the field, including acanthocytes with irregular projections
Admixed echinocytes and small round dense spherocyte-like cells
Remaining red cells normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes
Single segmented neutrophil visible; platelets present
Very low magnification limits assessment of fine red cell and leukocyte detail; embedded scale bar appears miscalibrated
describe_en: Very low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows a diffuse population of spiculated red cells, including acanthocytes and echinocytes, distributed evenly across a well-spread area of the smear, along with small dense spherocyte-like cells. No schistocytes are appreciated, and platelets appear adequate; a single neutrophil is present. At this magnification detailed leukocyte morphology such as hypersegmentation cannot be reliably assessed. In the setting of alectinib therapy, findings are consistent with drug-induced acanthocytosis.

ddx.vs: Artifactual echinocytes are confined to certain smear areas and show uniform regular projections, while true acanthocytosis is present in well-spread areas with irregular spicules.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia in liver disease
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; distinguished by clinical liver failure rather than by red cell appearance.
Inherited forms are lifelong with Kell antigen or neurologic abnormalities, not acquired under a specific drug.
